summary: Extends the Layer Two Tunneling Protocol (L2TP) so it can carry Differentiated Services information. Before this, L2TP had no standard way to negotiate service differentiation for its control connection or its data sessions, so tunneled traffic could not be treated according to its priority class.

eli5.summary: A tunnel under a river treats every car the same. This document lets the tunnel know which cars are ambulances, so important traffic can be treated differently from ordinary traffic.
